release_notes:
- Added in-app GitHub Issue Reporter (ISSUE / NAHLASIT button after Debug toggle) supporting direct authenticated API submission and 1-click pre-filled browser fallback with automatic token/path redaction
- Replaced static ONLINE pill with a dynamic Live SPECTRA Activity Status Pill (READING %, UPDATING %, MAPPING EEPROM, AI WORKING, GITHUB SYNC, EXPORTING, MONITORING, READY, IDLE)
- Fixed language preset persistence across restarts (eliminated App.jsx mount race + atomic locked ui_prefs.json writes)
- Fixed Linux loopback / IPv6 / WebKitGTK POST /api/ui_prefs 403 CSRF false positives while strictly blocking foreign & cross-site sandboxed origins
- Added optional Ticket Number / Custom Filename Prefix input with live sanitized preview for diagnostic exports (JSON, CSV, TXT, capture bundles)
- Upgraded Tab 02 Telemetry with device-aware 6-topology Digital Twin (Jura Single/Dual/Smart Connect, Nivona, Kalerm, Jetinno), honest NO FRAME handling, port-resetting Oscilloscope, conditional AS: shunt card, and collapsible Live Raw Telemetry Frame Inspector
